title: Customizing the Zscaler Client Connector Theme

blocks.text: You can customize (white label) the Zscaler Client Connector app to display your company’s logo and company name instead of the Zscaler logo on the app. If you use Zscaler Client Connector for Windows and macOS, you can also display your company’s logo and name in end user notifications.

This feature is available only for Zscaler Client Connector version 4.9 and later for Windows and for Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later for macOS, Android, Android on ChromeOS, and iOS. Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Client Connector Theme.
On the Text Settings tab, click Edit and enter the name of your organization in the Organization Name.
This name replaces the Zscaler company name on end user notifications.
Select the <OS> Images tab for the app platform to customize, and configure the following logos:

Wordmark: Click Upload and browse to or drag and drop the logo file to use when the app is in Light mode. The logo displays in the center of the login window and on the top-left corner of the main app window. The file must be a .PNG file and Zscaler recommends it be at least 600 pixels on a transparent background.

Wordmark (Dark Theme): (Optional) Click Upload and browse to or drag and drop the logo file to use when the app is in Dark mode. The logo displays in the center of the login window and on the top-left corner of the main app window. The file must be a .PNG file and Zscaler recommends it be at least 600 pixels on a transparent background. If you don’t upload a separate logo file in this field, the app uses the Wordmark logo file for both Light and Dark mode.

This option is available only for Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later in the Modern UI. For Zscaler Client Connector versions 4.9-4.10 for Windows and for the Classic UI, the app uses the Wordmark file regardless of Light or Dark mode.

Logomark: Click Upload and browse to or drag and drop the logo file to use on the Home screen in the Modern UI. If you use Zscaler Client Connector version 4.9 and later for Windows or version 5.0 and later for macOS, this logo file also displays in end user notifications.The file must be a .PNG file and Zscaler recommends it be a square shape that is at least 240 pixels on a transparent background.

blocks.text: After you customize a theme, you can select Enable Custom Theme on the app profile to display your logos and company name in the app and end user notifications for users with that app profile. The logos are updated for the end user during the next policy update.
The company logo from the Wordmark displays on the main app screen in Light mode:
The company logo from the Wordmark (Dark Theme), if entered, displays on the main app screen in Dark mode:
The company logo also displays on the login page:
The first time an end user enrolls in Zscaler Client Connector, the Zscaler logo displays on the login page because the app doesn’t have access to the custom logo files from the policy.
The Logomark displays in the Orb on the Home screen:

If you use Zscaler Client Connector version 4.9 and later for Windows or version 5.0 and later for macOS, the Logomark displays as the notification logo and the Organization Name displays as the company name in end user notifications:
The custom theme doesn’t display for end user notifications (EUNs) from Internet & SaaS. You can customize those notifications in the Zscaler Admin Console.
